exercises.why: **прервали** — прерва́ть (perfective): to abort, to cut short, to discontinue or suspend abruptly; to interrupt (a conversation, act, etc.); to break off, to sever. Wiktionary: пре- + рвать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to abort, to cut short, to discontinue or suspend abruptly
(transitive) to despise, to hold in contempt
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прекра́сный — beautiful; прерва́ть — to abort, to cut short, to discontinue or suspend abruptly; презира́ть — (transitive) to despise, to hold in contempt; пресле́довать — to pursue, to chase.

**представлю** — предста́вить (perfective): to present, to offer; to produce, to show; to introduce, to present; to imagine, to picture, to fancy, to conceive, to envision. Wiktionary: пред- + ста́вить.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to cease, to end, to discontinue
(literary) to be (at some place), to stay, to remain
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прекрати́ть — to stop, to cease, to end, to discontinue; пребыва́ть — (literary) to be (at some place), to stay, to remain; предста́вить — to present, to offer; предложи́ть — to offer, to proffer.
**предлагаю** — предлага́ть (imperfective): to offer, to proffer; to propose, to suggest. Wiktionary: пред- + -лага́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: There is a lot of work to do.
exercises.why: **предстоит** — предстоя́ть (imperfective): to lie ahead, to be at hand, to be in the offing; to have to do something in the future. Wiktionary: пред- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: предлага́ть — to offer, to proffer; предполага́ть — to assume, to suppose; председа́тель — chairman, president; предстоя́ть — to lie ahead, to be at hand, to be in the offing.
